verdict.rationale: Martin is a cloud-based personal assistant that holds email, calendar and message data, so choosing a storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection or where data is stored. Community comments raise general privacy concerns but say nothing about residency, so they do not count either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
